objective: Add a bounded qualification-evidence freshness lease that binds evidence to a qualification surface and drift vector, enforces maximum age/generation/TTL, supports quarantine and revocation, and rejects stale/replayed/tampered leases without executing qualification or granting production authority.

research_inputs.finding: Hosted Evals guidance describes repeatable test data, graders, and runs, while documenting a deprecation timeline that makes provider-neutral evidence lifecycle important.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: Lease verification binds evidence and provenance digests to a provider-neutral qualification surface rather than a vendor-hosted eval identity.

research_inputs.finding: Traces are useful for diagnosing workflow behavior, while repeatable datasets and evaluation runs support change benchmarking over time.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: The contract accepts caller-supplied qualification evidence and prevents reuse after qualification-surface, policy, ABI, generation, or time drift.

research_inputs.finding: Agentic validation must include temporal validity and runtime evidence maintenance; assurance evidence can degrade after updates, drift, and changing workflows.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: The lease includes evidence age, expiry, generation, drift components, critical-drift requalification, quarantine, and revocation controls.

features: policy generation and platform ABI binding
maximum evidence age and bounded lease TTL

benchmark.scope: local Python control-plane freshness verification overhead; excludes qualification, attestation, network, storage, accelerators, kernel scheduling, and production approval latency

rollback.rollback_scope: remove the evidence-freshness module, tests, runner, evidence registration, and metadata; retain prior tagged evaluator-consensus release

limitations: The ledger verifies caller-supplied qualification surfaces and leases; it does not inspect live models, tools, routes, hardware, environments, or benchmark services.
Drift labels are caller-supplied evidence and are not independently detected by this contract.
Freshness is not truth: an unexpired lease may still refer to incorrect, incomplete, or fraudulent qualification evidence.
No physical accelerator, TPM, secure enclave, independent builder, live multihost deployment, or independent external security review was exercised.
The benchmark measures local Python control-plane overhead and excludes qualification execution, attestation, network, storage, accelerator, kernel scheduler, and approval latency.
The real-task validation is a deterministic local fixture and does not establish agent quality, general intelligence, browser autonomy, robotics, or production efficacy.
This evidence does not claim AGI capability, production approval, or superiority to Linux.
